info.description: One alumni card on the homepage. ⚠ NOT shared.point: the source shape is {quote, name, classOf, photo}, and squeezing it into title/body would have made the class year part of a sentence and left nowhere for the photograph — so an editor could never have added the entry the section is waiting for (docs/07 A4). `photo` is optional; the card falls back to the school monogram, which is a design decision that stays in Astro.
